lines.text: Thanks for calling Brightside Family Clinic, this is Nofa. How can I help you today?
Hi! I need to move my appointment on Thursday — something came up at work.
Of course. I can see your two-thirty with Dr. Chen on Thursday. I have Friday at ten in the morning, or Monday at four-fifteen. Which works better for you?
Friday at ten would be perfect.
Done. The clinic system has confirmed Friday at ten A M with Dr. Chen, and I've just texted you the details. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. Have a lovely day!
